summary: Tested the annual Certificazione compensi feature end to end. Backend: 16/16 new pytest tests pass, and the iter73 regression suite passes 19/19. Checked GET /api/ritenute/certificazione: per-supplier months, partial payments counted pro-quota, payments outside the year excluded, cross-year invoices split correctly, compensazione payments excluded, versato_il set from the F24 RIT key, totals and non_soggette, company isolation, 422 on a bad anno, 401 without auth. Checked the PDF endpoint: one page per supplier, 2 pages for all suppliers, Italian 404 messages, isolation. Regression: /ritenute/mese and scadenze-fiscali RIT items now also carry compenso/imponibile_ritenuta, versato and its undo update the certificazione, and the F24 PDF works. Frontend: the toggle, year select, rows, totals, warning, empty state, the disabled print-all button, both PDF buttons (new tab, 200 application/pdf), the error toast (mocked 404), the deep link ?vista=certificazione, and the month view (versato/annulla/F24) all work. Layout checked on desktop and mobile; the mobile table scrolls horizontally.

minor.issue: The PDF footer always says the ritenute 'sono state ... versate entro il giorno 16 del mese successivo', even when some are still marked 'da versare' on the same page.

ui_bugs.issue: On error the catch block runs JSON.parse on the blob. If the body is not JSON (for example a 502 HTML page), JSON.parse throws inside the catch, no toast is shown and the rejection is unhandled. Wrap it in try/catch.

issues: Typo in the cert-avviso text: 'segnale come versate' should be 'segnalale come versate'.

action_items: Make the PDF footer wording conditional when ritenute are still da versare
Guard JSON.parse in the apri() error path
critical_code_review_comments: _ritenute_mesi excludes compensazione payments from the cumulative total as well, so an invoice settled partly by a credit note never accrues the ritenuta on that portion. This is probably intended because the NC reduces the compenso, but confirm the business rule.
The supplier key falls back to the denominazione when party_id is missing. It is used in data-testid and the ?party= URL, which works but is fragile with special characters.
The year select only covers the last 6 years.
seed_data_creation: The test creates and cleans its own TEST_T74 companies, suppliers, invoices, payments and a session (test_session_t74_admin). All of it was cleaned up at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_iteration74_certificazione_compensi.py -n 0. Use T74_KEEP=1 T74_RUN=740074 to keep data for the UI; clean with `python tests/test_iteration74_certificazione_compensi.py clean`. Dates are hardcoded for 2026 (server date 2026-11-14); RIT-2026-09 must stay within the scadenze-fiscali window. UI login: cookie session_token=test_session_t74_admin plus localStorage fe_company_id. PDF tabs show about:blank in headless (blob URL), so verify via the network response.
